rationale: The failure occurs during Electron binary installation because the extract-zip native binary requires GLIBC_2.33 on a stated Debian Bullseye/glibc 2.31 environment. build is the direct package/install route. Node loader frames and the generic npm suggestion do not establish a Node integration or upstream bug. The concrete image, versions, command and nested error may suffice for investigation; a minimal install project/container is also defensible because no complete runnable project is supplied. #51963 shares Cannot find native binding but is an arm32 prebuild availability report, not this x64 glibc-version mismatch.
